c1_neg_window.ifc.pathology: serving window OverallHeight/Width set to -50/-50 (schema-invalid IfcPositiveLengthMeasure) on a habitable aero-violation space
c1_neg_window.ifc.spec_rationale: IfcPositiveLengthMeasure must be > 0; a non-positive dim yields no valid area (DM1975 art.5 numerator = valid windows only) -> the space remains the aero violation it already is; FZK total stays 5.
c1_neg_window.ifc.prefix_defect_expected: pre-fix fabricates +2500 m2 -> space compliant -> FZK 4 (false pass)

c1_zero_window.ifc.spec_rationale: zero area is not a valid window; space stays a violation; FZK 5.
c1_zero_window.ifc.prefix_defect_expected: none (0 is falsy; pre-fix also fell through) — no-crash control

c1_absurd_pos_window.ifc.pathology: serving window OverallHeight/Width set to 500/500 (250000 m2, >> 74.5 floor)
c1_absurd_pos_window.ifc.spec_rationale: a 250000 m2 window on a 74.5 m2 floor is non-physical -> untrustworthy -> aero unbounded -> space undetermined (FZK viol 5->4, undet 0->1); target NEVER compliant.
c1_absurd_pos_window.ifc.prefix_defect_expected: pre-fix AND C1-B both return 250000 (positive) -> target compliant -> FZK 4 (false pass C1-B does not catch).

c2_no_unit.ifc.spec_rationale: no declared length unit -> scale undefined -> model cannot be measured -> must be REFUSED (not assumed metres).
c2_no_unit.ifc.prefix_defect_expected: pre-fix: calculate_unit_scale silently returns 1.0 -> proceeds and emits a normal verdict (the defect).

c2_mm_declared.ifc.pathology: SI length unit prefix set to MILLI (declared millimetres)
c2_mm_declared.ifc.spec_rationale: a declared length unit is resolvable -> scale 0.001 -> the checker runs (it must NOT refuse a file that declares its unit). GATE-N over-reject guard.
c2_mm_declared.ifc.prefix_defect_expected: n/a (control): both pre-fix and fix process it.

c2_contextdependent_unit.ifc.pathology: SI metre replaced by IfcContextDependentUnit (custom 'SMOOT', LENGTHUNIT)
c2_contextdependent_unit.ifc.spec_rationale: an IfcContextDependentUnit has no defined SI relationship -> scale unresolvable -> calculate_unit_scale silently returns 1.0 -> must REFUSE.
c2_contextdependent_unit.ifc.prefix_defect_expected: pre-fix AND the presence-only C2-B BOTH proceed at scale 1.0 (the hole that disqualified C2-B; C2-F resolvability check refuses).

c2_foot.ifc.spec_rationale: a conversion unit chaining to SI is resolvable (scale 0.3048) -> the checker must PROCESS it, not refuse (GATE-N over-reject guard).
c2_foot.ifc.prefix_defect_expected: n/a (control): both process; the C2-F fix must keep processing it.
